items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: When I got there, the bandmaster put me on Elmer Moore, told me he wanted me to be Elmer Moore's second.

ctx.x: Did you play a bugle or anything there too? No, it was right on it as a trumpet player. Right on it as a trumpet player. With the band then?

It was right on it as a trumpet player. Mm-hmm. And then I got my further music knowledge there from a trumpet player by the name of Elmer Moore, who was a soulist. When I got there, the bandmaster put me on Elmer Moore, told me he wanted me to be Elmer Moore's second. That's whenever Elmer Moore, who was a chief trumpet player, couldn't make concerts and I had to play souls. I had to play those souls. Yeah, play souls. And that's where I got the part of knowing the technical part about knowing the souls. Now,…
